fusions.name: Slam Shut
fusions.desc: Slams the target, dealing 16 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrenching Grip
fusions.desc: Collapses a wall of force 6 tiles long for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward and dealing 28 damage. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Hold the Line
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 12 seconds, and pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hammered Home
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
